notes.title: Update May 5th, 2023: Bug fixes, props additions
notes.content:
Props assets added: 
-"Change my mind" meme desk prop
-Telephone
-Cup & Cup-Spit

Characters:
-OneShot: Niko's lineart was thickened
-CrossCode: Lea now has an alt. version: Default = canon hair, alt. version = hair down. Find and click the yellow T-shirt to switch

Bug fixes: 
-Fixed a glitch for Scene Mode where if there's a wait command before scene starts, the first dialogue's character position is offset.
-Fixed a bug where launching music selection without selecting music triggered the appearance of a spooky faceless ghost 
-Various minor quality of life issues
